preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 20,000 inclusive.
The number of citizens m is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in citizens)
preconditions.description: Each citizen lives in a city xi and works in a city yi, where xi and yi are distinct cities between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The total number of puppies k is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of puppies given to citizens q is between 0 and the minimum of m and k inclusive.
The number of puppies given to guardians e is between 0 and the minimum of n - 1 and k inclusive.
The sum of puppies given to citizens and guardians is equal to the total number of puppies k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= m for ai in citizens_with_puppies)
postconditions.description: Each index ai of citizens to give a puppy is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= n - 1 for bi in guardians_with_puppies)
postconditions.description: Each index bi of guardians to give a puppy is between 1 and n - 1 inclusive.
The number of distinct citizens to give a puppy is equal to q.
The number of distinct guardians to give a puppy is equal to e.

postconditions.expression: all(is_happy(c, citizens_with_puppies, guardians_with_puppies, roads) for c in citizens)
postconditions.description: Each citizen is happy, either by having a puppy or by seeing puppies along their path to work.
